Workload_Description: Fabric Tools now includes an interactive AI Notebook Playground: experiment with PySpark using a multi-step AI assistant that plans, generates, and executes code in Fabric Spark. Use the right sidebar to track plan steps, results, and iterate your data workflows.
FabricTools_Docs_Description: Documentation for Fabric Tools, now featuring the AI Notebook Playground.
FabricTools_Docs_Introduction: Get started with Fabric Tools and the new AI Notebook Playground
Workload_Hub_Workload_Slogan: Tools that make working with Fabric a breeze.
Workload_Hub_Workload_Description: Fabric tools enable developers to create and manage Fabric workspaces, automate package installs, explore OneLake, and run PySpark notebooks assisted by a multi-step AI Copilot.
PackageInstallerItem_Description: Install package configurations into Fabric workspaces. Try the new AI Notebook Playground for PySpark/code experiments.
OneLakeExplorerItem_Description: Provides OneLake file exploration and editing capabilities. Open the AI Notebook Playground easily from your workspace.
HelloWorldItem_Description: Experiment with PySpark notebooks powered by a multi-step AI assistant. Use the right sidebar to plan, generate, and evaluate PySpark code with Azure OpenAI and execute on Fabric Spark for Lakehouse scenarios.
